description: Every emitted signal must carry a retrievable https source URL; an unattributed signal must not be emitted at all.

input.topic: multi-ERP consolidation tenders in mining and industrial groups

rubric.condition: Every item in the signals array has a source_url field whose value starts with the literal prefix https://.
The output contains zero occurrences of the substring http:// (insecure scheme).
The output contains the literal key name source_url at least 3 times, one per signal.
